<thought>We need to locate a retrosynthetic template that converts an aliphatic carboxylic acid into an amide (the reverse of amide formation). Using the available functional group names, we will search the template catalog with functional_groups_broken set to "aliphatic carboxylic acid" and functional_groups_formed set to "amide".</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
